description: Use to read research you already paid for, or to preflight a new call. Set view: reports (saved SERP, keyword and AI-Overview reports; kind/siteId/limit), report (one report with GSC, AIO and tracked-keyword context; pass reportId), estimate (cache hits and estimated cost before spending; pass tool and its arguments, e.g. queries/terms/seeds/limit/maxCostUsd). Spending tools stay separate on purpose: research_keywords, get_keyword_metrics, get_serp_results and check_ai_visibility each buy something different.

view.description: Which read to run; see the tool description for each view.

name: get_research
title: Read saved research or preflight a paid call
